name: erihub
description: Erihub — a CSS + vanilla JS UI framework connecting Eritrean talent worldwide. Bootstrap-equivalent component set with a distinct forest-green, gold, and blue brand identity.
author: Mussa Mohammed Idris -Erihub Initiative

scripts.build:css: cat src/css/erihub-core.css src/css/erihub-components.css > dist/erihub.css && cleancss -o dist/erihub.min.css dist/erihub.css
scripts.build:js: cp src/js/erihub.js dist/erihub.js && terser dist/erihub.js -o dist/erihub.min.js --compress --mangle
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
